description: Source code for geometric routines used in qhull, including functions for copying points, cross product, determinant calculation, joggle input, and area computations.

methods.name: qh_copypoints
methods.description: Creates a copy of an array of points with memory allocation.

methods.name: qh_crossproduct
methods.description: Computes the cross product of two 3D vectors.

methods.name: qh_determinant
methods.description: Calculates the signed determinant of a square matrix, with near-zero detection.

methods.name: qh_detjoggle
methods.description: Determines default maximum joggle value for a set of points.

methods.name: qh_detmaxoutside
methods.description: Calculates the target outside distance for tests.

methods.name: qh_detroundoff
methods.description: Computes maximum roundoff errors for geometric computations.

methods.name: qh_detsimplex
methods.description: Calculates the determinant of a simplex with apex and base points.

methods.name: qh_distnorm
methods.description: Returns the distance from a point to a hyperplane.

methods.name: qh_distround
methods.description: Calculates maximum roundoff error for distance computations.

methods.name: qh_divzero
methods.description: Divides numer by denom, handling near-zero denominators.

methods.name: qh_facetarea
methods.description: Returns the area of a facet, using triangulation or projection.

methods.name: qh_facetarea_simplex
methods.description: Calculates the area of a simplex defined by apex and vertices.

methods.name: qh_facetcenter
methods.description: Returns the Voronoi center for a facet's vertices.

methods.name: qh_findgooddist
methods.description: Finds the best visible good facet for a point.

methods.name: qh_furthestnewvertex
methods.description: Returns the furthest unvisited new vertex for a facet.

methods.name: qh_furthestvertex
methods.description: Returns the furthest vertex in one facet from another.

methods.name: qh_getarea
methods.description: Sets total area and volume of the convex hull.

methods.name: qh_gram_schmidt
methods.description: Implements Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization.

methods.name: qh_inthresholds
methods.description: Checks if a normal vector is within threshold bounds.

methods.name: qh_joggleinput
methods.description: Randomly joggles input points to avoid degeneracies.

methods.name: qh_setdelaunay
methods.description: Projects points onto paraboloid for Delaunay triangulation.

methods.name: qh_sethalfspace
methods.description: Sets point to dual of halfspace relative to feasible point.

methods.name: qh_sethalfspace_all
methods.description: Generates dual for halfspace intersection with feasible point.

methods.name: qh_sharpnewfacets
methods.description: Detects if facets form an acute angle (in different quadrants).

methods.name: qh_vertex_bestdist
methods.description: Returns nearest distance between vertices.

methods.name: qh_vertex_bestdist2
methods.description: Returns nearest distance and vertices between a set of vertices.

methods.name: qh_voronoi_center
methods.description: Computes the Voronoi center for a set of points.
